habitatVocabulary.composition: A fantasy biome contains composable Habitat tags. Physical surface, shore bands and POI proximity are evaluated differently but use the shared Habitat term.

biomeEligibility.taxonomyStatus: PROSPECTIVE_NOT_FINAL: the initial biome list is still being defined. Legacy water-as-biome data is not the new gameplay taxonomy.
biomeEligibility.ownerRequirement: Materials appear only in their applicable fantasy biome. Biomes ignore real-world climate; Water is now a habitat within a biome.
biomeEligibility.climateRule: Fantasy Snow can occur in Arizona or any real climate. No real climate or real season gate is implied by a biome name.
biomeEligibility.eligibilityRule: The classified gameplay biome must be in allowedBiomeIds. An empty allowlist is reserve-only, never any-biome.
biomeEligibility.sparseAreaRule: Missing biome coverage does not grant permission to spawn outside the allowlist.
biomeEligibility.geographyLimitation: Current checked-in biome boundaries and water clipping describe old rendering data. Gameplay needs a fantasy-biome assignment plus separate water/shore context; no universal region catalog is assumed.

visibility.ownerApprovedConcept: Show all currently collectible material tiers plus exactly the next tier.
visibility.ruleExample: At proposed level 8, tiers 0-2 are collectible, tier 3 may be visible but locked, and tiers 4-7 stay hidden.
visibility.implementationStatus: Design direction only; no runtime visibility change is made by these files.

rarity.meaning: Relative scarcity proposal, independent of unlock tier and player level.

boundaries: This is a pool of 68 active-harvest material ideas, not an instruction to activate all of them or generate all their recipes.
23 loose/fallen/shed/drop concepts moved to future-drops.proposed.json. Acorn and Cedar Needles are explicitly deferred, not renamed into harvestables.
Every direct-world-harvest entry has an explicit living plant/fungus or worked deposit source and an active harvest action. Harvest ability, tools and success calculations remain undecided.
Existing 44-item crafting proposal remains the small connected crafting graph. Matching gathering annotations are aligned with this pool; optional alternatives are not simultaneous approved sources.

The earlier six-family suggestion is superseded by eight proposed core families with ten possible yield items, adding requested Snow and Water/Ice. Flax, Iron and Sugarcane remain later worker candidates.
Acquisition modes for new items are proposed; existing worker wheat/wood/stone/blackberry modes are preserved.

Eggs and milk retain private-animal-group harvest identity. Restaurant Water and financial Energy retain POI cooldown pickup identity. Worker Water is an additional source of the existing item, not a replacement POI system.
Mineral Water and Green Water are optional distinct item ideas, never implicit substitutes for basic Water in biscuits or other existing recipes.
Green Water may support a fast-grow tonic concept, but effect/target are unselected. Deferred resource regrowth and Home crops are not reactivated.
Wood/crops remain in-world. Home generators and ingredient trade-boundness are separate future systems.
Crafting is time/queue based. Coal is only a proposed recipe ingredient, never an implicit Energy cost for crafting buildings.
Per-material skill growth and level-based harvest-success RNG remain discussion-only.

allowedBiomeIds is explicit and never contains water. Land/water/shore habitat, POI, water-kind and time hints are separate axes. Prospective ecology labels are notes, not active additional biome IDs.
New 2D icons should be generated in the established project UI theme; this proposal produces no images.
Prefab path existence is verified. Most remaps are explicitly proxy/recolor ideas; model shapes were not visually certified for all 86 ideas.
